reason: The text explicitly demonstrates collaboration between leadership and people across multiple scenes: (1) All the tribes of Israel come to David saying 'we are your bone and flesh,' (2) All the elders of Israel make a covenant with King David and anoint him together, (3) David and all the people of Israel work together to bring up the Ark of God ('David and all the house of Israel were bringing up the Ark'), (4) They celebrate and worship together before the Lord with music and instruments, and (5) David distributes provisions to 'all the people, to all the multitude of Israel,' with 'all the people' returning to their homes. The repeated use of 'David and all/the people' throughout emphasizes their unified action and shared purpose.
